average-time-first-re-tickets-created-da.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT AVG(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_first_agent_reply) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created)) / (60 * 60) AS 'Average Time (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %1:DATE_GROUP% AND tickets.date_first_agent_reply <> NULL
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
average-time-first-re-tickets-created-da.title: Average time to first response in tickets created <1:date group> grouped by <2:field group:tickets>

average-time-resolve-tickets-date-group-.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT AVG(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created)) / (60 * 60) AS 'Average Time (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND tickets.date_resolved = %1:DATE_GROUP% AND tickets.date_resolved <> NULL
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
average-time-resolve-tickets-date-group-.title: Average time to resolve tickets <1:date group> grouped by <2:field group:tickets>

average-total-wait-tickets-resolve-date-.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT AVG(tickets.total_user_waiting) / (60 * 60) AS 'Total Waiting Time (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND tickets.date_resolved = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
average-total-wait-tickets-resolve-date-.title: Average total waiting time for tickets resolved <1:date group> grouped by <2:field group:tickets>

most-active-tickets-status-created-date.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets_messages.ticket.subject, COUNT() AS 'Messages', tickets_messages.ticket.person, tickets_messages.ticket.date_created, tickets_messages.ticket.agent
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE %1:STATUS_GROUP:tickets:tickets_messages.ticket% AND tickets_messages.ticket.date_created = %2:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY tickets_messages.ticket.id
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
LIMIT 100
most-active-tickets-status-created-date.title: Most active tickets <1:status group:tickets> created <2:date group>

most-active-unresolved-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets_messages.ticket.date_created, COUNT(tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1 AND tickets_messages.is_agent_note = 0) AS 'Total Agent Replies', COUNT(tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 0) AS 'Total User Replies'
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.ticket.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
GROUP BY tickets_messages.ticket
ORDER BY @'Total Agent Replies' DESC
LIMIT 100;
most-active-unresolved-tickets.title: Most active unresolved tickets

most-popular-people-email-domains.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total People'
FROM people
GROUP BY people.primary_email.email_domain
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
LIMIT 100
most-popular-people-email-domains.title: Most popular primary email domains

most-popular-ticket-email-domains.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
GROUP BY tickets.person_email.email_domain
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
LIMIT 100
most-popular-ticket-email-domains.title: Most popular ticket [email domains]

most-popular-ticket-labels.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM labels_tickets
GROUP BY labels_tickets.label
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
LIMIT 100
most-popular-ticket-labels.title: Most popular ticket [labels]

number-ticket-messages-written-agent-day.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Messages'
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1
SPLIT BY tickets_messages.person
GROUP BY CONCAT(DAYOFMONTH(tickets_messages.date_created), ' ', MONTHNAME(tickets_messages.date_created), ' ', YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created)) AS 'Period'
ORDER BY YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC, MONTH(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC, DAYOFMONTH(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC
number-ticket-messages-written-agent-day.title: Number of ticket messages written per agent per [day]

number-ticket-messages-written-agent-mon.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Messages'
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1
SPLIT BY tickets_messages.person
GROUP BY CONCAT(MONTHNAME(tickets_messages.date_created), ' ', YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created)) AS 'Period'
ORDER BY YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC, MONTH(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC
number-ticket-messages-written-agent-mon.title: Number of ticket messages written per agent per [month]

number-ticket-messages-written-agent-wee.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Messages'
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1
SPLIT BY tickets_messages.person
GROUP BY CONCAT('Week ', WEEKOFYEAR(tickets_messages.date_created), ', ', YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created)) AS 'Period'
ORDER BY YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC, MONTH(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC, WEEKOFYEAR(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC
number-ticket-messages-written-agent-wee.title: Number of ticket messages written per agent per [week]

number-ticket-messages-written-agent-yea.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Messages'
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1
SPLIT BY tickets_messages.person
GROUP BY YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created) AS 'Period'
ORDER BY YEAR(tickets_messages.date_created) DESC
number-ticket-messages-written-agent-yea.title: Number of ticket messages written per agent per [year]

number-tickets-created-date-grouped-by-x.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%, %3:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-created-date-grouped-by-x.title: Number of tickets created <1:date group> grouped by <2:field group:tickets> & <3:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-created-date-grouped-firs.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY DATE_OFFSET_GROUP(NOW(), tickets.date_first_agent_reply) AS 'Time Waiting', %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-created-date-grouped-firs.title: Number of tickets created <1:date group> grouped by first agent response time & <2:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-resolved-date-grouped-tim.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND tickets.date_resolved = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY DATE_OFFSET_GROUP(tickets.date_resolved, tickets.date_created) AS 'Time To Resolve', %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-resolved-date-grouped-tim.title: Number of tickets resolved <1:date group> grouped by time to resolution & <2:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-resolved-date-grouped-tot.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND tickets.date_resolved = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY DATE_OFFSET_GROUP(tickets.total_user_waiting) AS 'Time Waiting', %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-resolved-date-grouped-tot.title: Number of tickets resolved <1:date group> grouped by total waiting time & <2:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-resolved-date-grouped-x-y.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_resolved = %1:DATE_GROUP% AND tickets.status IN('resolved', 'closed')
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%, %3:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-resolved-date-grouped-x-y.title: Number of tickets resolved <1:date group> grouped by <2:field group:tickets> & <3:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-status-grouped-by-x-y.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE %1:STATUS_GROUP:tickets%
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%, %3:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-status-grouped-by-x-y.title: Number of tickets <1:status group:tickets> grouped by <2:field group:tickets> & <3:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-wait-agent-grouped-time-w.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
GROUP BY DATE_OFFSET_GROUP(NOW(), tickets.date_user_waiting) AS 'Time Waiting', %1:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-wait-agent-grouped-time-w.title: Number of tickets awaiting agent grouped by time awaiting agent and <1:field group:tickets>

number-tickets-wait-agent-grouped-total-.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
GROUP BY DATE_OFFSET_GROUP(tickets.total_user_waiting) AS 'Time Waiting', %1:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
number-tickets-wait-agent-grouped-total-.title: Number of tickets awaiting agent grouped by total waiting time and <1:field group:tickets>

oldest-unresolved-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT LINK(tickets.subject, 'ticket', tickets.id), tickets.date_created
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
ORDER BY tickets.date_created
LIMIT 100
oldest-unresolved-tickets.title: Oldest unresolved tickets

organizations-longest-total--wait.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT SUM(tickets.total_user_waiting) / (60 * 60) AS 'Total Wait (Hours)', COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets', AVG(tickets.total_user_waiting) / (60 * 60) AS 'Average Wait (Hours)'
FROM tickets
GROUP BY tickets.organization
ORDER BY SUM(tickets.total_user_waiting) DESC
LIMIT 100
organizations-longest-total--wait.title: [Organizations] with longest total waiting time

organizations-longest-total-first-reply-.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / (60 * 60) AS 'Total Wait (Hours)', COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets', AVG(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / (60 * 60) AS 'Average Wait (Hours)'
FROM tickets
GROUP BY tickets.organization
ORDER BY SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) DESC
LIMIT 100
organizations-longest-total-first-reply-.title: [Organizations] with longest total first reply waiting time

people-longest-total--wait.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT SUM(tickets.total_user_waiting) / (60 * 60) AS 'Total Wait (Hours)', COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets', AVG(tickets.total_user_waiting) / (60 * 60) AS 'Average Wait (Hours)'
FROM tickets
GROUP BY tickets.person
ORDER BY SUM(tickets.total_user_waiting) DESC
LIMIT 100
people-longest-total--wait.title: [People] with longest total waiting time

people-longest-total-first-reply-wait.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / (60 * 60) AS 'Total Wait (Hours)', COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets', AVG(tickets.total_to_first_reply) / (60 * 60) AS 'Average Wait (Hours)'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %PAST_YEAR%
GROUP BY tickets.person
ORDER BY SUM(tickets.total_to_first_reply) DESC
LIMIT 100
people-longest-total-first-reply-wait.title: [People] with longest total first reply waiting time

percent-tickets-created-date-replied-hou.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT PERCENT(tickets.total_to_first_reply < 3600) AS 'Percentage'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.date_created = %1:DATE_GROUP% AND tickets.total_to_first_reply > 0
GROUP BY %2:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
percent-tickets-created-date-replied-hou.title: Percentage of tickets created <1:date group> replied to within an hour, grouped by <2:field group:tickets>

percentage-tickets-resolved-24-hours.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT PERCENT(tickets.date_resolved <> NULL AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_resolved) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tickets.date_created) < 24 * 60 * 60) AS 'Percentage'
FROM tickets
percentage-tickets-resolved-24-hours.title: Percentage of tickets resolved within 24 hours

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-date-c.query:

FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
ORDER BY tickets.date_created
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-date-c.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by [date created]

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-a.query:
DISPLAY TABLE

FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
ORDER BY tickets.date_last_agent_reply
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-a.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by [last agent reply]

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-u.query:
DISPLAY TABLE

FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
ORDER BY tickets.date_last_user_reply
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-last-u.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by [last user reply]

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-number.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets_messages.ticket.person, COUNT() AS 'Total Messages', tickets_messages.ticket.agent
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.ticket.status = 'awaiting_agent'
GROUP BY tickets_messages.ticket
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-number.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by [number of messages]

tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-time-w.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT LINK(tickets.subject, 'ticket', tickets.id), tickets.date_user_waiting, tickets.person, tickets.agent
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
ORDER BY tickets.date_user_waiting
tickets-awaiting-agent-ordered-by-time-w.title: Tickets awaiting agent ordered by [time waiting]

tickets-awaiting-agent-split-by-field-or.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets.id, tickets.subject, tickets.person, tickets.date_created, tickets.agent
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent'
SPLIT BY %1:FIELD_GROUP:tickets%
ORDER BY %1:ORDER_GROUP:tickets% DESC
LIMIT 100
tickets-awaiting-agent-split-by-field-or.title: Tickets awaiting agent split by <1:field group:tickets> ordered by <2:order group:tickets>

tickets-created-date-grouped-labels.query:
DISPLAY TABLE, BAR
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.labels.label <> NULL AND tickets.date_created = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY tickets.labels
tickets-created-date-grouped-labels.title: Tickets created <1:date group> grouped by labels

tickets-resolved-date-grouped-by-agent-r.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT_DISTINCT(tickets_log.ticket_id) AS 'Tickets Resolved'
FROM tickets_log
WHERE tickets_log.action_type = 'changed_status' AND tickets_log.id_after = 200 AND tickets_log.person.is_agent = 1 AND tickets_log.ticket.status = 'resolved' AND tickets_log.date_created = %1:DATE_GROUP%
GROUP BY tickets_log.person
ORDER BY @'Tickets Resolved' DESC
LIMIT 100
tickets-resolved-date-grouped-by-agent-r.title: Tickets resolved <1:date group> grouped by agent resolving ticket

tickets-split-by-labels.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT tickets.id, tickets.subject, tickets.person, tickets.date_created, tickets.agent
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.labels.label <> NULL
SPLIT BY tickets.labels
ORDER BY tickets.date_created DESC
LIMIT 100
tickets-split-by-labels.title: Tickets split by labels

total-messages-written-agent-month-year.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT()
FROM tickets_messages
WHERE tickets_messages.person.is_agent = 1 AND tickets_messages.date_created = %PAST_YEAR%
SPLIT BY tickets_messages.person
GROUP BY PRINT(MONTH(tickets_messages.date_created), MONTHNAME(tickets_messages.date_created))
ORDER BY MONTH(tickets_messages.date_created)
total-messages-written-agent-month-year.title: Total messages written per agent per month in past year

total-tickets-open-more-week.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total', COUNT(tickets.status = 'awaiting_agent') AS 'Total Awaiting Agent', COUNT(tickets.status = 'awaiting_user') AS 'Total Awaiting User'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent') AND tickets.date_created < %PAST_WEEK%
total-tickets-open-more-week.title: Total tickets open more than a week

unresolved-high-priority-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT LINK(tickets.subject, 'ticket', tickets.id), tickets.date_created, tickets.priority
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.priority.priority = 1 AND tickets.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
ORDER BY tickets.date_created
LIMIT 100
unresolved-high-priority-tickets.title: Unresolved [high priority] tickets

unresolved-urgent-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT LINK(tickets.subject, 'ticket', tickets.id), tickets.date_created, tickets.urgency
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.urgency > 7 AND tickets.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
ORDER BY tickets.date_created
LIMIT 100
unresolved-urgent-tickets.title: Unresolved [urgent] tickets

users-most-unresolved-tickets.query:
DISPLAY TABLE
SELECT COUNT() AS 'Total Tickets'
FROM tickets
WHERE tickets.status IN ('awaiting_user', 'awaiting_agent')
GROUP BY tickets.person
ORDER BY COUNT() DESC
LIMIT 100
users-most-unresolved-tickets.title: Users with most unresolved tickets
